history.summary: Freehold D19 1BR (657 sqft) at $980k / $1,492 psf, 6 min from Kovan NEL — but the unit is asking ~20% below the $1,862 median and the URA rate is just 0.82%/yr on a thin 11-txn series. The deep median discount plus near-zero appreciation and a weak Elo (891, 97-212 record) flag a problem, not a bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold near Kovan MRT at a low $980k quantum is the positive, but the score_1000 of 678 is misleading — Elo 891 and a 97-212 arena record are poor, the 0.82%/yr appreciation is essentially flat, and a 20% gap below median PSF usually signals a compromised unit (low floor, poor facing, or layout). 657 sqft is also large for a 1BR, suggesting the cheap PSF is partly size. Concerns offset the freehold/location appeal.

history.summary: There is a genuine-looking discount — S$1,492 psf vs a project average of ~S$1,767 (range S$1,295-1,928) — but it rests on razor-thin data (psf_cohort_txns=1, appreciation_txns=11) in a 41-unit boutique freehold with poor exit liquidity. The 657 sqft '1BR' label is also suspect (Kovan 1BRs are 355 sqft).
history.rating_rationale: Web data shows Park Residences Kovan averaging ~S$1,767 psf (S$1,295-1,928 across only 13 lifetime-window transactions), so the S$1,492 psf ask does look cheaper than the project mean, loosely supporting the dossier's -10.9% age_adj and -17.2% cohort premium. But per v3.4 I must be skeptical of big negatives built on tiny samples: psf_cohort_txns=1 and appreciation_txns=11 make the cohort discount statistically fragile, and a 41-unit boutique block trades infrequently (illiquid exit over a 5-7yr hold). The 657 sqft unit is likely a 2BR or dual-key, not the 355 sqft 1BR the dossier labels — so the comparison band may be mismatched. Freehold is not a forward edge (v3.4). Real-but-uncertain value plus thin liquidity nets to a low-confidence Neutral.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns=1 — the -17.2% cohort discount has a single comparable behind it
appreciation_txns=11 — thin history for the 0.82% CAGR and the value read
41-unit boutique project = low transaction volume / weak exit liquidity
657 sqft labelled 1BR but project 1BRs are 355 sqft — likely a 2BR/dual-key, band mismatch
catalysts: Freehold tenure (durable, though not a forward price edge per v3.4)
Near Kovan MRT (NEL) and Heartland Mall; D19/OCR forward region ~+4%
